summary: Defined workflow schema and persistence layer for visual editor state. Created TypeScript interfaces (Workflow, WorkflowNode, WorkflowConnection, and input/query types) in src/types/workflow.ts. Extended the graph type system with workflow/workflow_node/workflow_connection node types and has_node/connects_to edge types. Implemented WorkflowPersistenceService with full CRUD operations (createWorkflow, getWorkflowById, listWorkflows, updateWorkflow, deleteWorkflow) using transactional Neo4j queries. Added composite indexes for query performance. All 35 tests pass.
